Ready to be the center of attention at your next festive event? ✨

There is nothing quite like the timeless allure of a handwoven saree. Our **Pure Silk Saree - Emerald Green** is a masterclass in traditional luxury. Crafted from 100% pure silk, it features a rich, lustrous lacquered finish that drapes like an absolute dream, creating a graceful, regal silhouette that moves beautifully with you. 

The highlight of this masterpiece is the stunning, intricate gold Zari work running along the border, capturing the rich heritage of South Asian craftsmanship. Whether you style it with a classic velvet blouse and statement jewelry like our model, or keep it modern and minimal, this saree is guaranteed to make a lasting impression. 

✨ **Product Details:**
* **Product Name:** Pure Silk Saree - Emerald Green
* **Price:** Rs. 8500
* **Features:** 100% Pure Silk, Handwoven, Exquisite Zari Work, Premium Lacquered Finish
